Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded from a search snippet (GenoPro) that Prince William’s paternal grandmother was Princess Mary of Great Britain, conflating generations and relying on an unreliable/uncorroborated source. In reality, William’s father was Prince Frederick of Hesse-Kassel (1771–1845), whose mother was Louise of Denmark and Norway—making Louise the correct paternal grandmother. The error arose from misinterpreting search results and not verifying with authoritative sources before asserting the conclusion.
